crusadecraft.task.ameliorer_relations.de: Every day, the ruler chosen at the Dovecote thinks better of you (based on the chancellor's Diplomacy).
crusadecraft.task.fabriquer_revendicatio: The chancellor forges rights over the province chosen at the Chancery Table; once ready, a scroll arrives at the Dovecote.
crusadecraft.proposal.non_agression.desc: A 60-day pact: neither will attack the other.
crusadecraft.proposal.commerce.desc: 40 days of trade: a little gold every day, and their esteem (merchants love it).
crusadecraft.proposal.passage.desc: 30 days to cross their lands under arms.
crusadecraft.proposal.alliance_defensive: Each defends the other if attacked. Until broken.
crusadecraft.proposal.alliance.desc: A full alliance: you fight together. Until broken.
crusadecraft.proposal.vassalisation.desc: Demand their homage: their provinces count towards your titles, and they pay you a share of their income and levies, under the contract below.
crusadecraft.proposal.tribut.desc: Make them pay a tenth of their income every day for 20 days. They only yield to strength or fear, and will resent you.
crusadecraft.diplo.op.dejure: Rivals for the same de jure kingdom
crusadecraft.diplo.op.tribute: You impose a tribute on them
crusadecraft.diplo.block.vassal: Impossible with a vassal or a liege.
crusadecraft.diplo.block.rank: They hold too high a title to pay you homage: create a higher title first.
crusadecraft.diplo.block.players_tribute: You cannot demand tribute from another player by letter.
crusadecraft.diplo.block.players_insult: You do not insult another player by pigeon.
crusadecraft.diplo.seal_needed: If they accept, you will have to seal their answer with the Royal Seal.
crusadecraft.diplo.to_player: This is another player: they will decide themselves when your letter arrives.
crusadecraft.diplo.take_mail.tip: Arrived letters become items to read (right-click). Still in flight: %s.
crusadecraft.diplo.nobody: You know no realm yet. Explore: approach their villages.
crusadecraft.diplo.gift.tip: Send a gift of %s gold: their opinion of you rises (a greedy ruler appreciates it more).
crusadecraft.diplo.insult.tip: Their opinion drops (−30); you gain a little dread and prestige. They may turn hostile.
crusadecraft.diplo.chancellor.tip: Task your chancellor with improving relations with this realm, day after day.
crusadecraft.diplo.no_chancellor: You need a chancellor on the council.
crusadecraft.diplo.break.tip: Break this treaty: they will resent it, and you lose 15 prestige.
crusadecraft.diplo.opinion.title: What %s thinks of you
crusadecraft.diplo.tribute_in: Pays you a tribute of %s gold a day.
crusadecraft.diplo.tribute_out: You pay them a tribute of %s gold a day.
crusadecraft.diplo.hint: Write, give, propose: at the Royal Dovecote.
crusadecraft.diplo.gift_sent: A gift of %s gold leaves for %s.
crusadecraft.diplo.chancellor_sent: Your chancellor now tends relations with %s.
crusadecraft.diplo.tribute_paid: Tribute granted to %s: %s gold a day.
crusadecraft.diplo.refused: Request rejected: %s will get nothing from you.
crusadecraft.toast.mail.title: A pigeon at the dovecote
crusadecraft.toast.mail.one: A letter awaits you at the Royal Dovecote.
crusadecraft.toast.mail.many: %s letters await you at the Royal Dovecote.
crusadecraft.letter.gone: This letter no longer calls for an answer.
crusadecraft.letter.expired: Too late: the proposal has expired.
crusadecraft.letter.seal_tip: You need your Royal Seal in your inventory.
crusadecraft.letter.accept.subject: Answer: %s
crusadecraft.letter.accept.body: By this letter, %s accepts your proposal: %s. Let it be sealed with your seal, and it will take effect at once.
crusadecraft.letter.refuse.subject: Answer: %s
crusadecraft.letter.refuse.body.non_agre: Your proposal is rejected: %s will not tie its hands.
crusadecraft.letter.refuse.body.commerce: Our merchants care nothing for yours: %s declines your agreement.
crusadecraft.letter.refuse.body.passage: No foreign army shall tread our lands: %s refuses passage.
crusadecraft.letter.refuse.body.alliance: Not yet: %s will not shed its blood for you.
An alliance? For now, %s knows you too little.
crusadecraft.letter.refuse.body.vassalis: Bend the knee? Never: %s will stay free.
crusadecraft.letter.refuse.body.tribut: A tribute? Come and take it: %s will pay nothing.
crusadecraft.letter.homage.subject: Homage
crusadecraft.letter.homage.body: After careful thought, %s agrees to pay you homage on the proposed terms: tax %s%%, levies %s%%. Seal the contract and we shall be your vassals.
crusadecraft.letter.tribute.subject: Tribute granted
crusadecraft.letter.tribute.body: This once, %s yields: %s gold a day for %s days.
crusadecraft.letter.thanks.subject: Thanks
crusadecraft.letter.thanks.body: By this letter, %s thanks you for your gift of %s gold and will not forget your generosity.
crusadecraft.letter.outrage.subject: Outrage
crusadecraft.letter.outrage.body: Your letter was read before the whole court, and %s will not forget this affront.
crusadecraft.letter.expired.subject: End of a treaty
crusadecraft.letter.expired.body: The treaty "%s" with %s has come to an end.
crusadecraft.letter.ai_gift.subject: A gift
crusadecraft.letter.ai_gift.body: As a token of friendship, %s sends you %s gold. It will be paid into the treasury when you take this letter.
crusadecraft.letter.ai_offer.subject: Proposal: %s
crusadecraft.letter.ai_offer.body: By this letter, %s proposes a treaty: %s. If you agree, seal it.
crusadecraft.letter.ai_demand.subject: Demand for tribute
crusadecraft.letter.ai_demand.body: By this letter, %s demands a tribute of %s gold a day for %s days. A refusal would be ill received.
crusadecraft.letter.claim.subject: Rights over %s
crusadecraft.letter.claim.body: Sire, the archives speak: the crown holds rightful claims over %s. Here is the scroll that proves them.
crusadecraft.letter.player_treaty.body: %s proposes: %s. Seal this letter to accept.
crusadecraft.letter.player_homage.body: %s offers to make you their vassal: tax %s%%, levies %s%%. Pay homage to accept.
crusadecraft.letter.sealed.subject: Treaty sealed
crusadecraft.letter.homage_sealed.body: %s has paid you homage and becomes your vassal.
crusadecraft.letter.declined.subject: Proposal declined
crusadecraft.letter.gift.subject: A gift
crusadecraft.letter.gift.body: %s sends you %s gold, paid into your treasury.
crusadecraft.seal.no_research: The Royal Seal requires the "Chancery" research at the capital's University.
crusadecraft.seal.missing: You need your Royal Seal in your inventory.
crusadecraft.seal.foreign: This seal belongs to another crown.
crusadecraft.seal.bound: The seal now bears the arms of %s.
crusadecraft.seal.unbound: Not yet engraved with a realm's arms.
crusadecraft.seal.tip: Seals treaties, homages and titles. The first ruler to use it engraves it with their arms.
crusadecraft.claim.tip: Will serve as a casus belli.
crusadecraft.claim.started: Your chancellor looks into the crown's rights over %s.
crusadecraft.chancery.locked: The Chancery Table requires the "Chancery" research at the capital's University.
crusadecraft.chancery.title: Chancery — %s
crusadecraft.chancery.seal_needed: You need your Royal Seal in your inventory.
crusadecraft.chancery.next.short: For the title of %s: %s provinces, %s gold, %s prestige.
crusadecraft.chancery.create.tip: Seal the creation of the title: gold and prestige are spent, your rank rises.
crusadecraft.chancery.no_vassals: No vassal. At the Dovecote, offer vassalage to a neighbouring lordship.
crusadecraft.chancery.fabricating.none: The chancellor is fabricating no claim.
crusadecraft.chancery.claim.tip: Task the chancellor with fabricating a claim on this province.
crusadecraft.chancery.hint: Titles and contracts: at the Chancery Table.
crusadecraft.title.highest: You already hold the highest title.
crusadecraft.title.need_provinces: You need %s provinces (colonies and your vassals' provinces).
crusadecraft.title.not_vassal: This realm is not your vassal.
crusadecraft.toast.title.title: A new title
crusadecraft.toast.title.body: You are now %s: your domain is now a %s.
crusadecraft.tab.diplomatie.empty.body: The Royal Dovecote will send and receive your letters.
